title: Dental Tier-Difference Credit per Month by Billing Basis — Premium Billing Accounts Rate Note
content:
**Rate note.** For the tier-difference credit on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement after a dependent's Dental PPO Plans enrollment ended for loss of eligibility, the amount per month credited follows how the months were billed. The first case that holds decides.

| Billing basis of the months | Amount per month |
|---|---|
| The arrangement carries a prepay discount (only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, at 4 percent) and has issued a twelve-month invoice within twelve months before the credit date — the prepaid months were billed at that discount | the tier difference per month reduced by the prepay discount percentage |
| An exchange account that receives advance premium tax credit (Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly, with a monthly credit above zero on the account) — each month was billed net of the credit | the plan's premium for the tier billed before the drop less the account's monthly advance premium tax credit, never below zero, less the plan's premium for the tier after the drop less that credit, never below zero |
| Any other account | the tier difference per month |

The tier difference per month is the subscriber's Dental PPO Plans plan's monthly premium for the tier billed before the drop (the departed dependent's recorded tier) less its monthly premium for the tier after the drop (the subscriber's active enrollment's tier), never less than zero. A twelve-month invoice was issued within twelve months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its issue date to the credit date are fewer than 12. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted: a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it. The amount per month is carried unrounded into the credit.

**Hypothetical illustrations** (premium 96.40 before the drop, 47.85 after; tier difference 48.55).
- Annual Prepay with a twelve-month invoice issued four months ago: 48.55 less 4 percent, 46.608.
- Exchange account with a monthly credit of 60.00: 96.40 less 60.00 is 36.40; 47.85 less 60.00 is below zero, so 0.00; amount per month 36.40.
- Exchange account with a monthly credit of 20.00: 76.40 less 27.85, 48.55.
- Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly: 48.55.
